question: How ordinary Remote model slider Elevation includes keyboard in blurred backdrop and restores it

conclusions.claim: Ordinary slider routes through shared ElevatedPresentation. Capture is driven by service keyboard-visible state and absence of an already borrowed facade. No separate slider-versus-attachment keyboard flag is observed at these callers. Attachment has different sourceRepresentation; that is not proof of different keyboard substitution policy.

service+0x60 is active-presentation presence discriminator. +0x88 holds KeyboardFacadeSession. +0x90 is weak external facade. +0x98 lazy optional ElevatedPresentationKeyboardSubstitutionController, sentinel1 before resolution. +0x38 keyboard-visible bool.

Phone idiom raw0 only. Resolves UIKeyboard class and class methods activeKeyboard, usesInputSystemUI, setKeyboardAlpha:. All three methods must exist and usesInputSystemUI() must return false. Pointers stored in resolvedAccessors. Literals are base64 of reversed identifiers, retained in identities JSON.

activeKeyboard is dynamically cast to UIView. Choose source by walking superview while it differs from its window and its frame(in:window).minY > 0. Stop otherwise. Capture selected ancestor using snapshotViewAfterScreenUpdates(true). No scan of unrelated windows is present.

Convert selected bounds to its UIWindow coordinate space as keyboardRect. Create UIView(origin0,size keyboardRect.size), clipsToBounds=true. Snapshot frame origin0,size keyboardRect.size, add as child.

If primary snapshot nil, get selected.window K and K.screen.snapshotViewAfterScreenUpdates(true). Make same clipped keyboard-sized container. Set screen snapshot frame to K.convert(K.bounds,to:K.screen.coordinateSpace), then subtract keyboardRect.minX/minY from origin. Add to container. Raw fallback has no observed explicit nil check for screenSnapshot; independent adapter should reject nil before hiding keyboard.

Present caller passes hideKeyboard=true. After snapshot container exists invoke class setKeyboardAlpha: with CGFloat0. Capture returns retained KeyboardFacadeSession with snapshot, keyboardRect and restore closure. Shared presenter sets translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints=true, interaction=false, frame=keyboardRect and attaches snapshot to source-resolved parent view (x19+0x1f0). Exact parent field semantic name remains unclosed.

KeyboardFacadeSession deinit is MainActor isolated. It calls snapshot.removeFromSuperview then onDeinit. The captured callback calls UIKeyboard.setKeyboardAlpha(1). Core restoration is ownership driven. Full presenter dismissal/replacement release ordering remains partial.
ElevatedPresentationWindow.windowLevel = UIWindow.Level.statusBar - 1. NumericRawRepresentable operator symbol demangles to subtraction. This is a level policy, not evidence of making overlay key.

WillShow sets service keyboardVisible=true and reapplies alpha0 if active/borrowed facade exists. WillHide clears stored frame/visible flag and invokes update when previously visible. WillChangeFrame updates stored frame only while visible. Notification identifiers retained in identities report.

capture_order_followup.conclusion: Original direct-present source also hides live keyboard before mounting facade. Therefore blank snapshot cannot be attributed to a demonstrated ordering mismatch solely from this evidence. There is a separately source-proven callback+flush-before-hide API, but ordinary slider calling that API has not been proved.
capture_order_followup.local_diagnostic_suggestion: If testing mounted snapshot plus CATransaction.flush before alpha0, label it native lifecycle adaptation using the alternate facade sequence. Verify actual snapshot pixels before hiding and successful restore. A nonnil snapshot object does not establish nonblank rendered content.
